title: Surreal Eclipse Scene
description: A surreal scene features a golden three-faced bust wearing a laurel wreath on the left, with orange liquid dripping from its neck onto a purple base. On the right stands a tall pink stack of blocks covered in black and white dog silhouettes, also dripping orange and pink liquid. A woman in a long blue dress stands between them, touching the bust, with a solar eclipse in the black sky above and a field of purple flowers in the background.
prompt: Surreal scene with a golden three-faced classical bust wearing a purple laurel wreath on the left, orange liquid dripping from its neck. A woman in a flowing blue dress stands in the center touching the bust. To the right is a tall pink tower of blocks covered in black and white dog silhouettes with orange and pink liquid dripping down. Solar eclipse with red and purple circles in the black sky, purple flower field in the background, scattered classical heads and geometric symbols, dark mysterious atmosphere.
